mapper.select: SELECT * FROM media WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM media WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT m.* FROM media m JOIN app_user u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.status='PROBING' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND (m.probe_started_at IS NULL OR m.probe_started_at < #{cutoff}) ORDER BY m.created_at,m.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE media SET probe_token=#{token},probe_started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROBING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (probe_started_at IS NULL OR probe_started_at < #{cutoff}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_user u WHERE u.id=media.user_id AND u.status='ACTIVE')

UPDATE media SET status=#{status},kind=#{kind},metadata_json=#{metadataJson},error_code=#{errorCode}, error_message=#{errorMessage},updated_at=#{updatedAt},probe_token=NULL,probe_started_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROBING' AND probe_token=#{probeToken} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM app_user u WHERE u.id=media.user_id AND u.status='ACTIVE')
